values.note: 58 power-and-water sites plus 12-13 primitive tent-only sites. 50 of the RV sites are bookable online, 20-40 ft; three (16, 28, 50) are 20 ft, so too short for 23 ft; sites 26, 28, 33, 53, 54, 56 allow no slide-outs. 6 pull-throughs (18, 22, 23, 29, 30, 47). Reviews warn of narrow, hilly loop roads.

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245 (Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 8-4). Golden Age / Access pass holders call the office before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days at county campgrounds, then away 16 days. Gate closed 10 pm - 8 am.

values.note: $30 a night for an inland site, $34 for the 28 sites marked waterfront ('WF'); the same on a Tuesday in April 2027, a Tuesday and a Saturday in June 2027 (the season closes Oct 31, so no November date). Primitive tent sites $24. $10 fee on any cancellation.

fees.source: Bartow County WebTrac rental search, 'GW 002 (25')' $30.00, 'GW 003 (25') WF' $34.00 on 06/15/2027, 06/19/2027 and 04/13/2027; Campground Rules rev. 2024-06-19, read 2026-10-29

note: Bartow County Parks & Recreation campground on a Lake Allatoona peninsula, 224 Bartow Beach Rd SE, Cartersville. Swim beach and boat ramp. --Claude
